# True Rankings

> Predictive college football rankings — how good teams actually are. Not a poll. Not a committee. Rankings are always free.

## Site

- Home (this week's board): https://truerankings.com/
- Methodology: https://truerankings.com/methodology
- Canonical week URLs: https://truerankings.com/{year}/week/{week}
- Team pages: https://truerankings.com/teams/{slug}
- Matchups (TR+ vs market): https://truerankings.com/games/{team-a}-vs-{team-b}

## Machine-readable rankings

- Manifest: https://truerankings.com/rankings/manifest.json
- Week JSON: https://truerankings.com/rankings/{year}/week-{week}.json
- Week story: https://truerankings.com/rankings/{year}/week-{week}.story.json
- Live API (same origin): https://truerankings.com/api/rankings?year={year}&week={week}
- Team breakdown: https://truerankings.com/api/rankings/team/{Team%20Name}?year={year}&week={week}
- Matchup: https://truerankings.com/api/matchup?team_a={A}&team_b={B}&year={year}&week={week}

## How to cite

`True Rankings, {year} Week {week}, https://truerankings.com/{year}/week/{week}`

Rating name: **TR+** (True Rankings plus). Internal formula term FRS is methodology-only.

See /llms-full.txt for positioning, CTA rules, and monetization constraints (rankings never paywalled).
